description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about goodwill and service failures.

files.description: A Slack thread in #policy-updates between Skyway staff about goodwill and service failures, dated between 2026-09-08 and 2026-11-03: a normal working conversation; one message may carry each sentence below. It must contain these sentences word for word: "From November 1 goodwill is $60, or $120 with approval for two problems."; "$60 travel credit"; "two or more problems on the same trip: $120 with supervisor approval"; "This applies to every request handled from November 1, whatever the date of the flight.". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not end the thread with a summary of the answer. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
